roadmap.description: Start on Armageddon. Phone booth in the prologue, then Vavilov; loot every room because the story areas cannot be revisited.

roadmap.title: Forester village
roadmap.description: Reach Lesnaya station; get a skill tree to the maximum with polymers.

roadmap.description: Explore sectors, craft and upgrade weapons, farm combat kills, and talk to the animals before going to VDNH.

roadmap.title: VDNH and Exhibition
roadmap.description: Hedgie, vodka kills, Claire's parts and the apple dream.

roadmap.title: Testing grounds, hospital and Pavlov
roadmap.description: Clear all eight testing grounds, talk to every corpse and finish Pavlov.

roadmap.title: Lighthouse and ending
roadmap.description: Dewdrop, the Academy secret, final scans, chirper cleanup and the ending.

roadmap.title: Annihilation Instinct

roadmap.title: Trapped in Limbo

achievements.displayName: The Motherland Does Not Forget its Heroes
achievements.summary: Unlock all other achievements.

steps.text: Earn the other achievements; this one appears last.

achievements.description: Kill Hedgie without making a single shot / destroy all statues
achievements.summary: Defeat Hedgie without firing a single shot, or destroy all the statues.

guide.context: Make a manual save before the arena. If you fire a shot, reload that save and try again.

steps.text: Fight with melee only and keep your distance from Hedgie.
Zap the poles to power the statues so Hedgie's attacks smash them.
Jump his shockwave and wait a few moments after landing before you move in.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Belyash boss before the Theater.

steps.text: Fight the real Belyash boss before the Theater. Scan him first with the scanner; the ordinary Belyash does not count toward the scan list.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Hedgie boss.

steps.text: Fight Hedgie in the arena before the Exhibition. Scan him with the scanner first; he is a one-time boss.

achievements.summary: Defeat a Plyusch.

steps.text: Kill any Plyusch. Testing Ground 9 has a fight, and Plyusch also appears in the VDNH, Theater and Pavlov story.
Fire Cartridge works best, and works better with Polymer Jet. Do not spam shots, because the burn does damage over time.
steps.note: Plyusch resists plain gunfire. Mass Telekinesis helps with the mutants around him.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Natasha boss at the end of the Theater.

steps.text: Fight Natasha during the Theater story. Dodge her spin attack and missile barrages; Zvezdochka and Fat Boy work well.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Dewdrop boss on the beach.

steps.text: Dewdrop attacks as soon as you reach the beach with the dead whale. Scan him, then dodge his lasers and stomping legs and hit him with your best weapons.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Twins in the final boss fight.

guide.context: Make a save before the last story choice. Only the second option leads to the Twins; the first option gives the other ending. After the Twins, reload the save to get the first ending.

steps.text: At the last choice, pick the second option.
Beat the Left Twin in phase one, then the Left and Right Twins together in phase two.
Stock healing items, ammunition and upgrades first. Scan both Twins for the Scanner achievement.

achievements.description: Kill Belyash with a melee weapon
achievements.summary: Defeat the Belyash boss using melee weapons only.

guide.context: Make a manual save before the fight. Any gun shot fails the attempt, so reload the save and try again.

steps.text: Use only melee weapons, with upgrades and any buffs you have; the Axe is easiest. Do not fire any gun, even by accident.
Jump the shockwaves Belyash creates; his movements are easy to read.

achievements.summary: Fly out of Chelomey at the end of the prologue.

steps.text: Play through the Chelomey prologue and board the flight out when the story sends you to leave.

achievements.summary: Leave the Vavilov complex for Hawk Forester.

steps.text: Finish the Vavilov missions, return all four canisters to the birch tree, and follow the story out of the complex.

achievements.description: Take a train at the Lesnaya Maglev train station
achievements.summary: Board the train at the Lesnaya maglev station.

steps.text: At the station, talk to the four marked corpses while you look for the train ticket; the ticket is on the corpse near the house.
Pick the dialogue option that lets you sit down, then board the train. You cannot return to Forester afterward.

achievements.summary: Clear the VDNH complex.

steps.text: Finish the Exhibition: collect Claire's parts, then continue to her. The achievement comes after the cutscene and the apple dream that follow.

achievements.summary: Finish a performance at the Maya Plisetskaya Theater.

steps.text: Beat the Theater story to the end and leave through the Theater exit.

achievements.summary: Reach the hospital.

steps.text: Travel to the hospital marked in the lower right of the map and enter it.

achievements.summary: Finish exploring the Pavlov complex.

steps.text: Follow the story through the whole Pavlov complex until the area ends.

achievements.summary: Learn the secret of the AoC under the lighthouse.

steps.text: Take the story under the lighthouse and explore the underwater complex with Fila until the story reveals the secret.

achievements.summary: Finish the whole game on Armageddon difficulty.

guide.context: Do not change difficulty during the run. The last choice leads to two endings; see Murderous Beauty for when to save.

steps.text: Start a new game on Armageddon and play to the ending without lowering the difficulty.

achievements.description: Create a weapon in a crafting machine
achievements.summary: Craft a weapon in a crafting machine.

steps.text: In the Vavilov Seed Bank safe room, open a crafting machine and craft the Electro weapon from its blueprint.

achievements.summary: Craft five different types of weapons.

guide.context: Craft all five in one visit once you have the blueprints and materials.

steps.text: Collect the blueprints for Electro, MP, Pashtet, Fox, Dominator and Zvezdochka.
At a safe room crafting machine, craft five of them.
Disassemble the crafted weapons or load your earlier save so you get the materials back.

achievements.description: Upgrade a weapon to the maximum level
achievements.summary: Upgrade a weapon to its maximum level.

guide.context: Some upgrades come from Testing Ground chests.

Spend your materials at a safe room crafting machine to upgrade every tier.
Load your earlier save afterward to get your materials back.
steps.note: Do this only if you do not need the Swede upgrades now.

steps.text: Spend polymers on one skill tree at a time; the SHOK tree is recommended. By Forester you should have enough polymers.

achievements.summary: Use the phone booth in the Chelomey prologue.

guide.context: The prologue is the only chance in a normal run. If you leave without it, you need a new game.

steps.text: Near the fountain, find the pay phone booth on your left and interact with it.

achievements.summary: Talk to every corpse that can talk.

guide.context: A progress pop-up confirms each counted corpse; the counter may read 46 even though about 50 corpses exist. Five corpses cannot be talked to: the flower corpse on the Tereshkova floor, the corpse right of the Theater entrance, two in the fourth-floor Theater dressing room, and one outside the top floor of VDNH. The achievement often pops in Pavlov. Corpses in Vavilov, Forester, the mirror facility, the Exhibition and Pavlov are lost once you leave those areas. If the counter stalls near the end, progress carries over between playthroughs, and moving old saves aside before a fresh game has helped some players.

achievements.description: Kill 10 burning enemies, 10 electrified enemies, and 10 frozen enemies
achievements.summary: Take down ten enemies on fire, ten shocked and ten frozen.

steps.text: Use Fire Cartridges and your glove powers to set enemies on fire, shock them, and freeze them; kill them while they are in that state.
Track each of the three counts separately; you can finish them in the open world.

achievements.description: Get 25 kills with headshots using the PM
achievements.summary: Kill 25 enemies with aimed Makarov headshots.

steps.text: Aim the Makarov (PM) at the head of weakened enemies and kill them with the shot.
Using glove powers beforehand is fine if the pistol shot makes the kill. The Axe plus Makarov combination one-shots many heads.

achievements.summary: Freeze a Vova.

steps.text: Get the Absolute Zero upgrade for Frostbite, then freeze any Vova. It works whether or not the Vova is in the air.

achievements.description: Don't let a sprout grow into a mutant
achievements.summary: Kill a Sprout before it grows into a Mutant.

steps.text: In the Vavilov Cold Workshop, once a Sprout enters a dead body's head, kill it quickly.

achievements.description: Use Telekinesis to throw an object and knock down an Owl
achievements.summary: Knock down an Owl by throwing an object with Telekinesis.

steps.text: In the Vavilov Seed Bank, pick up an object with Telekinesis and throw it at an Owl. The Owl falls and blows up when it hits the wall.

achievements.description: Get drunk with vodka and kill 5 enemies
achievements.summary: Kill five enemies while drunk from vodka.

guide.context: Vodka is rare, so do not disassemble it.

steps.text: Find vodka in cabinets on the VDNH entry floor.
In the VDNH Exhibition, go down to the bottom floor, through the door with the pink bee, down the stairs and into the room full of Mother plants.
Drink the vodka from your inventory, then kill five Sprouts that swarm you. The drunk effect lasts one to two minutes.

achievements.description: Kill 3 or more enemies with a single Railgun shot
achievements.summary: Kill three or more enemies with one Railgun shot.

steps.text: Craft the Railgun first; its Neuromodule comes from Plyusch, and the blueprint is near Testing Ground 6.
After the Bug in the System mission starts, go to Testing Ground 8 in the center of the open world, where Vovas and Pchelas stand.
Group the enemies with Mass Telekinesis, line up the Railgun and fire one shot through three.

achievements.summary: Hit 20 enemies with a car.

steps.text: Drive a car into enemies in Forester and the open world until the counter reaches 20. The number of hits a car can take depends on the difficulty, so find extra cars.

achievements.summary: Enter the ORB lab.

steps.text: Follow the story to the ORB lab and ride the elevator in.

achievements.description: Use a Strekoza for the first time
achievements.summary: Ride a Strekoza once.

steps.text: Use the Strekoza transport vehicle outside the elevator near the BEA-D to travel to the next area.

achievements.summary: Send all eight BEA-Ds to NORA's brain.

guide.context: After collecting all eight, return to the Teardrop area, solve the puzzles using the schematic, and beat the boss while finishing the delivery.

steps.text: After you get the Technostasis glove ability in the ORB lab, activate it near enemies and kill three while it runs.

achievements.summary: Destroy three M4D-5 robots back to back while they hop on a single leg.

steps.text: Take the Klusha melee weapon from the impaled robot beside the corpse at the Hotel.
Hit an M4D-5's leg so it hops on one foot, then kill it; repeat for three robots in a row. Technostasis makes this easier.

achievements.description: Destroy 15 enemies using the neuropolymeric launch module
achievements.summary: Destroy 15 enemies using the Alionka neuropolymer launch module.

steps.text: Take the Alionka item at the Hotel; a second Alionka appears later and can also heal.
Use the Alionka on groups of enemies; the count updates a few seconds after the blast.

guide.context: The six blueprints are: Secateur (lab), Klusha Handle, Secateur Energy Supercharger, Secateur Magazine, Klusha Blade and Electricity Coil Supercharger.

steps.text: Open every chest and kill robots for materials.
Take each blueprint and upgrade both weapons at a crafting machine.

achievements.summary: Gather 3,826 apples during Trapped in Limbo.

guide.context: 4,137 apples exist, and replays count.

steps.text: Collect apples through the levels. The final dash of the first sliding level yields roughly 3,000 in a few attempts with a boosted gun.

steps.text: On the first sliding level at about 36% progress, go to the platform with the large target.
Jump from the platform and fly into the bee itself; time it after the bee passes the Lootyagin spot.

achievements.displayName: The Casino Isn't Always in the Black
achievements.description: Get ALL items from the slot machine
achievements.summary: Get every item from the slot machine.

guide.context: Items you buy stay when you return to the frozen beach hub. Pick different items, upgrades and firearms; a repeat does not help.

steps.text: Have 5,646 or more apples, then roll the slot machine repeatedly.
Keep rolling until you have received every item; the achievement pops on the last one.

achievements.description: Complete the Plateau of Responsibility without dying
achievements.summary: Finish the Plateau of Responsibility (second sliding level) without dying.

guide.context: Easy difficulty has more save points. If you die, reload the last save.

steps.text: Play the level on easy and reload the last save after any fall or crash.
Enter the booth at the end.

achievements.description: Complete the Tower of Memory without dying
achievements.summary: Finish the Tower of Memory (first climbing level) without dying.

guide.context: If you die, reload the last save.

steps.text: Climb the tower and reload the last save after any fall, then finish.

achievements.summary: Finish the Cliff of Perseverance (second climbing level) without dying.

guide.context: If you die, reload the last save.

steps.text: Climb the cliff and reload the last save after any fall, then enter the booth at the end.

achievements.description: Complete the Avenue of Speed without dying
achievements.summary: Finish the Avenue of Speed (first sliding level) without dying.

guide.context: If you die, reload the last save.

steps.text: Reload your last save after a fall or crash and keep going. Use melee against enemies and the gingerbread man boss.

achievements.summary: Finish the Trapped in Limbo levels without dying.

guide.context: All four levels must be done without a death. The final goose stage is not needed. If you die, reload the last save.

steps.text: Finish all four levels, one after another, without a single death.

achievements.description: Collect an extra 77th gold coin in the Trapped in Limbo DLC
achievements.summary: Collect a 77th gold coin in the Trapped in Limbo DLC.

steps.text: Collect gold coins until the count passes 76 and reaches 77.

achievements.description: Hear the beautiful song while taking in the fantastic view
achievements.summary: Stand at the big window and hear the chirper's story about the mysterious tune.

steps.text: Whip ahead past the dolphin place and turn left to the large round window and the chirper on the ground.
Pick up the chirper, face the window and stay still until P-3 finishes speaking. Do not move around.

achievements.summary: Find all three Hunter's Stashes.

guide.context: Stashes are yellow crates; the tracker updates when you find each.

collectibles.name: Hunter's Stash 1
collectibles.location: Facility area: once the Bumblebee has crashed, head left to the fountain; the yellow crate sits at its middle.
collectibles.method: Open the stash.

collectibles.name: Hunter's Stash 2
collectibles.location: After talking to Terentiy, use the pyro ability to enter a small cave on the short left path behind the crashed Komar.
collectibles.method: Open the stash.

collectibles.name: Hunter's Stash 3
collectibles.location: After the dolphin arena, drop to the broken bridge area, swim to the next hole, whip upward to the hole with the last stash.
collectibles.method: Open the stash.

achievements.summary: Destroy the Robogirl boss at Chelomey.

steps.text: Make use of the Pchelas until the Robogirl exposes her chest core, then fire at that core.
Dodge her attacks and keep shooting the core until she falls.

achievements.summary: Complete the Enchantment Under the Sea story.

steps.text: Beat MOR-4Y; the achievement unlocks at once.

achievements.description: Toss the ball back and forth with the dolphin three times
achievements.summary: Toss the ball to the dolphin and back three times.

steps.text: After Nastya and the Hunter, pick up a red ball from the boxes and take it to the right side to the dolphin.
Throw it to the dolphin and pick it up when it returns it. Do this three times; the achievement comes after the third return.

achievements.description: Pull yourself close to your enemy with the Whip
achievements.summary: Pull yourself to an enemy using the Whip.

steps.text: After the early fall cutscene, aim at an enemy and press E to whip toward them.

achievements.displayName: I'm here if you need to talk
achievements.summary: Talk to Terentiy.

steps.text: Near the crashed Komar, talk to the Rafik robot called Terentiy.

achievements.description: Swim beyond the underwater world's borders, ignoring warnings
achievements.summary: Swim past the edge of the undersea map despite the alerts.

steps.text: After you find scuba gear, swim far to the right until a danger sign appears, and wait for the achievement.

achievements.description: Fall in the water at Wave and get killed by Morays
achievements.summary: Drown in the water around Wave by letting Morays kill you.

guide.context: Do it right at the DLC's start; leaving the Wave complex ends the chance.

steps.text: Once the opening cutscenes finish at Wave, dive into the water and swim downward and outward until the Morays finish you.

achievements.description: Destroy all of the infected plants on the submarine
achievements.summary: Wipe out every infected plant aboard the submarine.

guide.context: There are 15 nests. Backtrack if you miss any.

steps.text: On the submarine, kill every Mother plant nest; use the scanner (Ctrl) to see nests through walls.
Check all rooms before you move the motors back into place.

achievements.summary: Defeat the RACCOON boss.

steps.text: Beat the RACCOON boss in the story.

achievements.summary: Finish Validol's mission without killing the three crystal patients.

guide.context: Killing the crystals that attack you is allowed.

steps.text: Talk to the patients after Validol asks.
When asked, choose "Let Nastya speak" twice, then "Let Nora speak".

achievements.description: Find the secret room with the fluffball
achievements.summary: Find the secret room with the fluffball.

guide.context: You need the polymer key first so your weapons and abilities work in the Residential Sector.

steps.text: In the first residential sector, near Nastya's clone, find the outhouse with a pattern lock.
Follow the cookies and nuts to the hole on the left to find the code; draw an X on the lock.
Open the lock, go in the toilet and enter the secret room.

achievements.description: Find the dolphin figurine in the secret room
achievements.summary: Locate the dolphin figurine inside the hidden room.

steps.text: After leaving the art gallery, win the arena fight, then the second large room fight.
Climb the stairs in that second room to the dark mural, then unlock the door in the neighboring room.

Find the door code from clues: the drawing on the wall, the Jackal Head email on a terminal, and the Rein in your Employee email on the terminal after the door. Enter it; the dolphin is on the table inside.

achievements.description: Open the secret room with observers
achievements.summary: Open the secret room with the observers.

guide.context: Do this soon after the sculptor conversation.

steps.text: In the burnt-out save room, use the terminal beside the locked door and accept both prompts.
In the big blue room, enter door 3 on the back left and take the key from the table.
Use the key on the locked door.

achievements.description: Use an industrial press to destroy robots
achievements.summary: Crush robots with an industrial press.

steps.text: In the housing area with conveyor belts, lead or freeze any robot so it rides the belt into the big press. The first press works.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Second Twin.

steps.text: Beat the Second Twin in the story.

achievements.displayName: For Chief's a Jolly Good Fellow
achievements.summary: Save Sechenov.

steps.text: Follow the story and save Sechenov.

achievements.summary: Beat CHAR-les.

steps.text: Defeat CHAR-les in the story.

achievements.summary: Complete the Blood on Crystal story.

steps.text: Finish the story to the end.
